annotation.evidence_span: MAY be defined to take precedence
annotation.interpretation_a: An HTTP-based protocol mapping can be configured to always override HTTPS RRs.
annotation.interpretation_b: An HTTP-based protocol mapping can be configured to not override HTTPS RRs.
annotation.justification: The use of 'MAY' twice creates ambiguity. It's unclear whether the mapping *can* take precedence, or whether it *might* be defined to take precedence, and if so, under what conditions. This leaves open the possibility of different implementations where some always override and others never do.
annotation.missing_information: The conditions under which the precedence is taken are not defined. It is unclear if the precedence is configurable, or if it is a default behaviour.
